description: Bounded Booky reflow addresses reproduced control overflow and recovery-control reachability under a controlled font-only 200 percent synthetic browser stress. Measured text and action-group geometry selects an expanded title/actions layout and restores the compact layout when fonts return to normal; available card height accounts for the measured heading. Existing automatic Android WebView text scaling is preserved; no duplicate font-scale bridge is added. Selected RU/EN actual-App cases cover enlarged control text, trusted critical actions, recovery, exact two-times fonts, normal-mode restoration and source-state preservation, alongside retained Calm movements and short-landscape navigation cases. Claims remain scoped to measured browser behavior and do not establish native OS Dynamic Type, installed-device or full A11Y-003 acceptance.
